Junior Investment Analyst

About the role:

We are looking for a Junior Investment Analyst to join the Total Return team. You will support portfolio managers on long/short equity ideas across MedTech and Insurance, build financial models in Excel and Python, and present trade ideas to senior PMs.

Requirements:

  • Strong financial modelling (DCF, LBO, comps).
  • Experience with Bloomberg and Excel/VBA.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Interest in long/short equity and macro analysis.

Nice to have:

  • Python or R for data analysis.
  • Prior buy-side internship.
Mock Capital Partners is an equal opportunity employer.
